<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The inner reason that all things return to their original state on Rosh HaShanah is that the drawing down of malchus through the nullification of the essence of the soul brings a higher revelation into the world, completing the purpose of creation as a dwelling place for Him.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="3">that the inner reason for this, that on every Rosh HaShanah all things return to their original state,</t>
    <t s="4">is,</t>
    <t s="5">that because the drawing down of malchus</t>
    <t s="6">(also the drawing down of malchus that is for the worlds)</t>
    <t s="7">is through saying before Him verses of Kingship,</t>
    <t s="8">the nullification from the aspect of the essence of the soul, which reaches and draws down the absolute will itself,</t>
    <t s="9">through this a more elevated revelation is drawn down also into the world.</t>
    <t s="10">For although regarding the worlds it is</t>
    <t s="11">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="12">the drawing down of the revealed will,</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="14">since the arousal and drawing down of the revealed will</t>
    <t s="15">(through an arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="16">is through the drawing down of the absolute will that comes through the nullification from the aspect of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="17">something similar to this is drawn down also into the world.</t>
    <t s="18">And through this the intention of the creation of the worlds is completed,</t>
    <t s="19">that there be a dwelling place for Him in the lower realms.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="22">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The verse "He will choose our inheritance for us, the pride of Yaakov" expresses the request that through the shofar, the essence of the soul rooted in Atzmus be revealed, connecting the inner Temple in every Jew's heart with the future Third Temple.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is "He will choose our inheritance for us, the pride of Yaakov,"</t>
    <t s="3">that the request of this verse</t>
    <t s="4">(and likewise the entire psalm)</t>
    <t s="5">which is recited before the shofar blast is,</t>
    <t s="6">that through the service of the shofar blast there will be</t>
    <t s="7">(in addition to the fulfillment of the commandment of shofar,</t>
    <t s="8">and the matter of repentance of shofar)</t>
    <t s="9">also a revelation of the essence of the soul as it is rooted in Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="10">for that the souls are rooted in Atzmus is because He chose in His free choice,</t>
    <t s="11">"He will choose for us."</t>
    <t s="12">And He draws down "our inheritance, the pride of Yaakov,"</t>
    <t s="13">for the revelation of this matter is in the point of Judaism,</t>
    <t s="14">"our inheritance,"</t>
    <t s="15">which dwells in the point of the heart in each one of Israel,</t>
    <t s="16">the holy Temple of Yaakov.</t>
    <t s="17">And according to what was explained above</t>
    <t s="18">(section 10)</t>
    <t s="19">that through the revelation of the root of souls, something similar to this revelation is drawn down also into the world, through which the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,</t>
    <t s="20">one may explain the connection between the interpretation that "the pride of Yaakov" refers to the Holy Temple within each one of Israel and the interpretation that it refers to the Third Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="21">for the main matter of a dwelling place in the lower realms will be in the Third Holy Temple</t>
    <t s="22">which will be built speedily in our days through our righteous Moshiach.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="23">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In addition to the general connection of the verse "He will choose for us" to shofar, it specifically relates to the following verse "God ascended with a blast," as the shofar reveals the essential choice of Atzmus in Israel, drawing down unlimited mercy.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that in addition to the connection of the verse "He will choose for us" etc. to the entire matter of the shofar blast,</t>
    <t s="2">it has a special connection to the verse</t>
    <t s="3">(that follows it)</t>
    <t s="4">"God ascended with a blast, Hashem with the sound of a shofar,"</t>
    <t s="5">about which our Sages expounded that when Israel take their shofars and blow before the Holy One, blessed be He, He rises from the Throne of Judgment and sits on the Throne of Mercy.</t>
    <t s="6">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="7">that the mercies drawn down through an arousal from below are limited according to the arousal from below.</t>
    <t s="8">And the connection of the two verses is,</t>
    <t s="9">that this taking of their shofars and blowing by Israel is not only an arousal from below, but through this the choice of Atzmus in Israel is revealed,</t>
    <t s="10">and therefore the mercies drawn down through this are unlimited mercies.</t>
    <t s="11">And there is drawn down from the Holy One, blessed be He, Himself</t>
    <t s="12">(from Atzmus)</t>
    <t s="13">to each and every one of Israel a writing and sealing for a good and sweet year, in the revealed and manifest good.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
